/home/shobhitg/src/multi-team-support/gui/landing_pen.lua
/home/shobhitg/src/multi-team-support/gui/landing_pen_terrain.lua

For each file, find EVERY string that can reach a player's screen, and report it in the structured output. That includes:
- chat/console messages: game.print, player.print, force.print, surface.print
- flying text (player.create_local_flying_text etc.)
- GUI: caption=, tooltip=, text= on LuaGuiElement .add{} or assignments, including strings inside localised-string tables
- commands.add_command name + help text, and every response string those commands print
- custom alerts, message dialogs, set_goal_description, chart/map tag names, anything else display-bound
- data-stage: localised_name/localised_description, prototype names/descriptions, setting prototypes
- error() messages and log() calls (classify as category 'error'/'log', visibility 'log-only' or 'debug' as appropriate)
- strings handed to other mods or external systems (remote interface return values that get displayed, Discord bridge payloads) → category 'external'

Include even tiny strings ("OK", "Cancel", "+", "▶", "×"). For icon/symbol-only strings add hazard 'symbol-only'. Do NOT report: code comments, table keys, event/style/prototype identifier names used only as identifiers, file paths, pattern strings for string.find, storage keys.

Per string, set:
- status: 'localised' if it is already a {"section.key", ...} locale reference, 'partial' if a locale reference is concatenated/mixed with hardcoded English, 'hardcoded' otherwise.
- dynamic: describe exactly how it is assembled if not static — every '..' concatenation, string.format, table.concat, tick-to-time formatting, number formatting, player/team name interpolation. This is critical: concatenated sentences are the main localisation hazard.
- visibility: 'player' (any player sees it), 'admin' (admin-only), 'debug' (behind a debug flag), 'external' (leaves the game: Discord, RCON, files), 'log-only'.
- hazards, any of: 'concat' (sentence built by concatenation), 'plural' (text hardcodes singular/plural like "1 slot"/"slots" or picks between them in Lua), 'sentence-fragments' (reusable fragment strings composed into sentences elsewhere), 'rich-text' (embeds [color=]/[item=]/[font=] tags), 'server-side-string' (built into a plain Lua string before display, so all players would get one language), 'discord-mirror' (also sent to Discord/external where a LocalisedString cannot go), 'symbol-only', 'sorted-by-text' (list sorted by the display string), 'newlines' (embedded \n layout).

files_scanned must list every file you read (repo-relative), even ones with zero strings. In notes, mention anything structurally interesting for the localisation plan (helper functions that build messages, message pipelines, patterns repeated across files).

Your final output is consumed by a script, not a human — return only the structured data.

1	-- Multi-Team Support - awards.lua
2	-- Author: bits-orio
3	-- License: GPL-3.0-or-later
4	--
5	-- Togglable "Team Awards" window. Shows leaderboards (top 3) for completed
6	-- achievements, grouped into three sections: Research, Science, Resources.
7	-- A per-player clock toggle ranks either by server time (elapsed since team
8	-- birth — the official awards basis) or by team online time (how long the team
9	-- was actually online when they finished — fairer across play schedules).
10	--
11	-- Data sources:
12	--   storage.tech_records      — keyed by tech_name
13	--   storage.milestone_records — keyed by "category:item@threshold"
14	-- Only achievements that at least one team has completed are listed.
15	
16	local nav     = require("gui.nav")
17	local helpers = require("scripts.helpers")
18	local records = require("scripts.records")
19	
20	local awards_gui = {}
21	
22	local FIRST_THRESHOLD = 0   -- matches milestones/engine.lua FIRST_THRESHOLD
23	
24	local CATEGORIES = {"research", "science", "resources"}
25	
26	local CAT_LABELS = {
27	    research  = "Research",
28	    science   = "Science",
29	    resources = "Resources",
30	}
31	
32	-- Milestone categories that belong in the Science tab. Everything else under
33	-- milestone_records is treated as a Resources achievement.
34	local SCIENCE_CATEGORIES = { science = true }
35	
36	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
37	-- Per-player state
38	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
39	
40	local function get_state(player)
41	    storage.awards_gui_state = storage.awards_gui_state or {}
42	    local s = storage.awards_gui_state[player.index]
43	    if not s then
44	        s = { category = "research", search = "", clock = "server" }
45	        storage.awards_gui_state[player.index] = s
46	    end
47	    s.search = s.search or ""
48	    s.clock  = s.clock  or "server"
49	    return s
50	end
51	
52	--- The record-entry field this player's clock mode ranks/displays by.
53	local function clock_field(state)
54	    return state.clock == "online" and "online_elapsed" or "elapsed"
55	end
56	
57	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
58	-- Data assembly
59	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
60	
61	--- Return an array of row tables for the Research tab.
62	--- Sorted by first-completion tick (chronological).
63	local function build_research_rows()
64	    local rows = {}
65	    local recs = storage.tech_records or {}
66	    for tech_name, rec in pairs(recs) do
67	        if rec.first then
68	            rows[#rows + 1] = {
69	                kind     = "tech",
70	                name     = tech_name,
71	                prefix   = nil,
72	                record   = rec,
73	                sort_key = rec.first.tick,
74	            }
75	        end
76	    end
77	    table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return a.sort_key < b.sort_key end)
78	    return rows
79	end
80	
81	--- Build a human-readable prefix for a milestone (quantity portion only).
82	local function milestone_prefix(threshold)
83	    if threshold == FIRST_THRESHOLD then
84	        return "First"
85	    end
86	    return string.format("%d ×", threshold)
87	end
88	
89	--- Return an array of row tables for either Science or Resources.
90	--- `want_science` = true selects milestones in SCIENCE_CATEGORIES; false selects
91	--- everything else.
92	--- Within the tab, rows are grouped by item (sorted by first-completion tick
93	--- of the item's earliest milestone), thresholds ascending within each item.
94	local function build_milestone_rows(want_science)
95	    local recs = storage.milestone_records or {}
96	
97	    -- Group: item_key ("category:item") -> list of {threshold, record}
98	    local groups = {}
99	    local item_first_tick = {}
100	    for key, rec in pairs(recs) do
101	        if rec.first then
102	            local category, item_name, threshold_str =
103	                key:match("^([^:]+):(.+)@(%-?%d+)$")
104	            if category and item_name and threshold_str then
105	                local is_science = SCIENCE_CATEGORIES[category] == true
106	                if is_science == want_science then
107	                    local group_key = category .. ":" .. item_name
108	                    if not groups[group_key] then
109	                        -- External (consumer-reported) milestones key as
110	                        -- "ext:<registry-category>@N" and have no item prototype;
111	                        -- show the registered noun (e.g. "Expanse cell") instead of
112	                        -- the raw registry key.
113	                        local display = item_name
114	                        if category == "ext" then
115	                            local spec = (storage.milestone_external or {})[item_name]
116	                            if spec and spec.noun then display = spec.noun end
117	                        end
118	                        groups[group_key] = {
119	                            item_name = item_name,
120	                            display   = display,
121	                            entries   = {},
122	                        }
123	                    end
124	                    groups[group_key].entries[#groups[group_key].entries + 1] = {
125	                        threshold = tonumber(threshold_str),
126	                        record    = rec,
127	                    }
128	                    local t = item_first_tick[group_key]
129	                    if not t or rec.first.tick < t then
130	                        item_first_tick[group_key] = rec.first.tick
131	                    end
132	                end
133	            end
134	        end
135	    end
136	
137	    -- Sort groups by earliest first.tick, thresholds ascending within a group.
138	    local sorted_group_keys = {}
139	    for k in pairs(groups) do sorted_group_keys[#sorted_group_keys + 1] = k end
140	    table.sort(sorted_group_keys, function(a, b)
141	        return (item_first_tick[a] or 0) < (item_first_tick[b] or 0)
142	    end)
143	
144	    local rows = {}
145	    for _, gk in ipairs(sorted_group_keys) do
146	        local grp = groups[gk]
147	        table.sort(grp.entries, function(a, b) return a.threshold < b.threshold end)
148	        for _, e in ipairs(grp.entries) do
149	            rows[#rows + 1] = {
150	                kind    = "item",
151	                name    = grp.item_name,
152	                display = grp.display,
153	                prefix  = milestone_prefix(e.threshold),
154	                record  = e.record,
155	            }
156	        end
157	    end
158	    return rows
159	end
160	
161	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
162	-- Rendering
163	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
164	
165	local PLACE_LABELS  = { "1st", "2nd", "3rd" }
166	local PLACE_COLOURS = {
167	    {1.00, 0.82, 0.20},  -- gold
168	    {0.80, 0.80, 0.85},  -- silver
169	    {0.80, 0.55, 0.30},  -- bronze
170	}
171	
172	local ICON_BUTTON_SIZE = 24
173	
174	--- True when `query` is empty or `name` contains query (case-insensitive).
175	--- `query` is expected to already be lowercased.
176	local function row_matches(name, query)
177	    if not query or query == "" then return true end
178	    return string.find(string.lower(name), query, 1, true) ~= nil
179	end
180	
181	--- Resolve the prototype + sprite path + localised name for a row.
182	--- Returns nil for the prototype if it no longer exists (modded item removed
183	--- mid-game); the caller falls back to a text-only cell in that case.
184	local function resolve_row_proto(row)
185	    if row.kind == "tech" then
186	        local proto = prototypes.technology and prototypes.technology[row.name]
187	        if not proto then return nil end
188	        return proto, "technology/" .. row.name, helpers.tech_label(proto)
189	    else
190	        local proto = prototypes.item and prototypes.item[row.name]
191	        if proto then return proto, "item/" .. row.name, proto.localised_name end
192	        -- Fluids (e.g. crude oil) live in a separate prototype table and use a fluid sprite.
193	        local fluid = prototypes.fluid and prototypes.fluid[row.name]
194	        if fluid then return fluid, "fluid/" .. row.name, fluid.localised_name end
195	        return nil
196	    end
197	end
198	
199	--- Drop rows whose internal name doesn't contain the (already lowercased) query.
200	--- When the query is empty the input array is returned unchanged.
201	local function filter_rows(rows, lower_query)
202	    if not lower_query or lower_query == "" then return rows end
203	    local out = {}
204	    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
205	        if row_matches(row.name, lower_query) then
206	            out[#out + 1] = row
207	        end
208	    end
209	    return out
210	end
211	
212	local function render_rows(parent, rows, query, sort_field)
213	    local has_query = query and query ~= ""
214	    local online    = sort_field == "online_elapsed"
215	
216	    if #rows == 0 then
217	        if has_query then
218	            local row = parent.add{type = "flow", direction = "horizontal"}
219	            row.style.vertical_align = "center"
220	            row.style.horizontal_spacing = 6
221	            row.add{
222	                type    = "label",
223	                caption = "No achievements match \"" .. query .. "\".",
224	            }
225	            row.add{
226	                type    = "button",
227	                name    = "sb_awards_clear_search_inline",
228	                caption = "Clear search",
229	                style   = "button",
230	            }
231	        else
232	            parent.add{type = "label", caption = "(no records yet)"}
233	        end
234	        return
235	    end
236	
237	    local tbl = parent.add{
238	        type                  = "table",
239	        column_count          = 4,
240	        draw_horizontal_lines = true,
241	    }
242	    tbl.style.horizontal_spacing = 12
243	    tbl.style.vertical_spacing   = 2
244	
245	    -- Header row
246	    local hdr_ach = tbl.add{type = "label", caption = "Achievement"}
247	    hdr_ach.style.font = "default-bold"
248	    hdr_ach.style.minimal_width = 100
249	    for i = 1, 3 do
250	        local h = tbl.add{type = "label", caption = PLACE_LABELS[i]}
251	        h.style.font = "default-bold"
252	        h.style.minimal_width = 200
253	    end
254	
255	    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
256	        local cell1 = tbl.add{type = "flow", direction = "horizontal"}
257	        cell1.style.vertical_align = "center"
258	        cell1.style.horizontal_spacing = 4
259	        cell1.style.minimal_width = 100
260	
261	        local proto, sprite, loc_name = resolve_row_proto(row)
262	        if proto then
263	            local tags
264	            if row.kind == "tech" then
265	                tags = { sb_awards_open_tech = row.name }
266	            else
267	                tags = { sb_awards_open_item = row.name }
268	            end
269	            local btn = cell1.add{
270	                type    = "sprite-button",
271	                sprite  = sprite,
272	                tooltip = loc_name,
273	                tags    = tags,
274	                style   = "slot_button",
275	            }
276	            btn.style.size    = ICON_BUTTON_SIZE
277	            btn.style.padding = 0
278	        else
279	            -- No prototype (external milestone, or a modded item removed mid-game):
280	            -- show plain text so the record is still listed.
281	            cell1.add{type = "label", caption = row.display or row.name}
282	        end
283	
284	        if row.prefix then
285	            cell1.add{type = "label", caption = row.prefix}
286	        end
287	
288	        local top = records.sorted_entries(row.record, sort_field)
289	        for i = 1, 3 do
290	            local e = top[i]
291	            local cell

113	    show_to_team(force_name, requester)
114	    pen_gui.build_pen_gui(requester)
115	
116	    local requester_tag = helpers.colored_name(requester.name, requester.chat_color)

118	    requester.print("You requested to join " .. team_tag

123	--- Accept a request. `member` is the clicking team member (any member, not just
124	--- the leader). Re-validates the request is still live and still targets this
125	--- member's team before mutating (DB-2), since many members can race to accept.
126	function M.accept_buddy_request(member, requester_index)
127	    local force_name = buddy_store.request_of(requester_index)
128	    -- Stale/already-handled: the frame this member clicked is orphaned; drop it.
129	    if not force_name then
130	        buddy_store.destroy_frames(requester_index)
131	        return
132	    end
133	    -- The clicker must really belong to the requested team. team_of sees through
134	    -- a temporary spectator force, so a member accepting while remote-viewing
135	    -- still qualifies; a genuine non-member's stale frame is torn down.
136	    if buddy_store.team_of(member) ~= force_name then
137	        if member.gui.screen[buddy_store.frame_name(requester_index)] then
138	            member.gui.screen[buddy_store.frame_name(requester_index)].destroy()
139	        end
140	        return
141	    end
142	
143	    local requester = game.get_player(requester_index)
144	    if not (requester and requester.valid) or not is_in_pen(requester) then
145	        -- Requester left or already spawned via another path — cancel cleanly.
146	        buddy_store.clear(requester_index)
147	        pen_gui.update_pen_gui_all()
148	        return
149	    end
150	
151	    local force = game.forces[force_name]
152	    if not (force and force.valid) then
153	        buddy_store.clear(requester_index)
154	        return
155	    end
156	    if not M.team_has_room(force) then
157	        local ft = helpers.force_tag(force_name)
158	        member.print("Your team is full — cannot accept "
159	            .. helpers.colored_name(requester.name, requester.chat_color) .. "." .. ft)
160	        if requester.connected then
161	            requester.print(helpers.team_tag(force_name) .. " is now full." .. ft)
162	            pen_gui.build_pen_gui(requester)
163	        end
164	        buddy_store.clear(requester_index)
165	        pen_gui.update_pen_gui_all()
166	        return
167	    end
168	
169	    -- Commit: this request is now consumed; tear its frames down on all members.
170	    buddy_store.clear(requester_index)
171	
172	    -- Anti-abuse: clear inventory if the player previously left this team.
173	    storage.left_teams = storage.left_teams or {}
174	    local is_rejoin = storage.left_teams[requester.index]
175	        and storage.left_teams[requester.index][force_name]
176	    if is_rejoin then
177	        if requester.character then requester.character.clear_items_inside() end
178	        requester.print("Your inventory was cleared because you previously left this team."
179	            .. helpers.force_tag(force_name))
180	    else
181	        pen_ops.grant_starter_items(requester)
182	    end
183	
184	    local member_tag    = helpers.colored_name(member.name, member.chat_color)
185	    local requester_tag = helpers.colored_name(requester.name, requester.chat_color)
186	    local team_tag      = helpers.team_tag_with_leader(force_name)
187	
188	    helpers.broadcast("[Team] " .. member_tag .. " accepted " .. requester_tag
189	        .. " into " .. team_tag .. ".")
190	
191	    local prev_force_name = requester.force.name
192	    requester.force = force
193	    -- Settle online clocks for the team the requester left and the one joined.
194	    team_clock.refresh(prev_force_name)
195	    team_clock.refresh(force_name)
196	
197	    -- If the team is still in pre-start staging, lock the new member down too.
198	    if pre_start.is_pending(force_name) then
199	        pre_start.enter_member(requester)
200	        if requester.connected then start_playing_gui.show(requester) end
201	    end
202	
203	    -- Auto-clear recruiting flag when the team is now full.
204	    -- Returns the force name to the caller so it can refresh team settings.
205	    local lfm_cleared_force = nil
206	    if not M.team_has_room(force) then
207	        storage.team_looking_for_more = storage.team_looking_for_more or {}
208	        if storage.team_looking_for_more[force_name] then
209	            storage.team_looking_for_more[force_name] = nil
210	            helpers.broadcast("[Team] " .. helpers.team_tag(force_name)
211	                .. " is no longer recruiting (team is now full).")
212	            lfm_cleared_force = force_name
213	        end
214	    end
215	    -- Only restore Default if the team isn't in staging; pre_start.enter_member
216	    -- already assigned the restricted group and must not be overwritten.
217	    if not pre_start.is_pending(force_name) then
218	        local default_group = game.permissions.get_group("Default")
219	        if default_group then default_group.add_player(requester) end
220	    end
221	    pen_ops.finish_spawn(requester)
222	    storage.pending_spawn_pop = storage.pending_spawn_pop or {}
223	    storage.pending_spawn_pop[requester.index] = force_name
224	    -- Spawn at the team's HOME-surface spawn point — where the leader
225	    -- originally spawned (force.get_spawn_position, the same expression the
226	    -- deferred spawn teleport uses) — never at the accepting member's current
227	    -- location: any online member can accept, and they may be on Vulcanus, a
228	    -- space platform, or deep in an outpost at the time.
229	    local home   = surface_utils.get_home_surface(force, requester.index)
230	    local placed = false
231	    if home and home.valid then
232	        local origin    = force.get_spawn_position(home)
233	        -- Wide search: the spawn area is the oldest, most built-up part of a
234	        -- base (and vanilla MTS places a water hole near the origin).
235	        local spawn_pos = home.find_non_colliding_position("character", origin, 32, 1)
236	        if spawn_pos then
237	            requester.teleport(spawn_pos, home)
238	            placed = true
239	        end
240	    end
241	    if not placed then
242	        -- No home surface / no free tile around the origin (shouldn't happen
243	        -- for an occupied team): fall back to the accepting member's
244	        -- CHARACTER (physical_*, never their remote view).
245	        local surf = member.physical_surface or member.surface
246	        local pos  = member.physical_position or member.position
247	        requester.teleport(
248	            surf.find_non_colliding_position("character", pos, 10, 1) or pos, surf)
249	    end
250	    ultracube_compat.after_spawn(requester)
251	
252	    storage.player_clock_start = storage.player_clock_start or {}
253	    if not storage.player_clock_start[requester.index] then
254	        storage.player_clock_start[requester.index] = game.tick
255	    end
256	
257	    helpers.broadcast("[Team] " .. requester_tag .. " has joined " .. team_tag .. ".")
258	
259	    local ft = helpers.force_tag(force_name)
260	    member.print(helpers.colored_name(requester.name, requester.chat_color)
261	        .. " has joined your team." .. ft)
262	    if requester.connected then
263	        requester.print("You joined " .. team_tag .. "." .. ft)
264	    end
265	    return lfm_cleared_force
266	end

11	-- update_player is called from the same one-second HUD refresh plus the

15	-- have nothing to toggle.

21

26	
27	-- 2 x 88px segments + 2px spacing + 2px frame padding each side. The API
28	-- cannot measure rendered element size, so the centering math hardcodes it.
29	local SWITCH_WIDTH = 88 * 2 + 2 + 2 * 2
30	
31	-- Reassigning a style resets the element's LuaStyle, so only write on change.
32	local function set_style(el, style_name)
33	    if el.style.name ~= style_name then el.style = style_name end
34	end

36	--- Create, refresh, or remove the switch for one player. force_name is the
37	--- player's effective team, or nil/non-team to remove.
38	function M.update_player(player, force_name)
39	    local screen = player.gui.screen
40	    local frame = screen[FRAME_NAME]
41	    if not (force_name and helpers.is_team_force(force_name)) then
42	        if frame then frame.destroy() end
43	        return
44	    end
45	
46	    -- Retire frames built before the translucent container style existed.
47	    if frame and frame.style.name ~= "mts_chat_switch_frame" then
48	        frame.destroy(); frame = nil
49	    end
50	
51	    if not frame then
52	        frame = screen.add{type = "frame", name = FRAME_NAME,
53	            style = "mts_chat_switch_frame", direction = "horizontal"}
54	        local row = frame.add{type = "flow", name = "mts_chat_row", direction = "horizontal"}
55	        row.style.horizontal_spacing = 2
56	        row.add{type = "button", name = M.SEG_GLOBAL, caption = "GLOBAL"}
57	        row.add{type = "button", name = M.SEG_TEAM,   caption = "TEAM"}
58	    end
59	
60	    local row      = frame.mts_chat_row
61	    local seg_g    = row[M.SEG_GLOBAL]
62	    local seg_t    = row[M.SEG_TEAM]
63	    local is_local = chat_channel.is_local_for(player)
64	    -- Under individual scope a click moves only the clicker, so the tooltips
65	    -- must not keep promising to move the whole team.
66	    local moves    = chat_channel.is_individual() and "you" or "your whole team"
67	    local whose    = chat_channel.is_individual() and "your messages"
68	                                                  or "your team's messages"
69	    -- Force-swapped into full spectate: the toggle keeps working, but team
70	    -- messages are also visible to co-spectators — the asterisk carries that.
71	    local swapped  = player.force.name ~= force_name
72	
73	    set_style(seg_g, is_local and "mts_chat_seg_inactive" or "mts_chat_seg_global_active")
74	    set_style(seg_t, is_local and "mts_chat_seg_team_active" or "mts_chat_seg_inactive")
75	    seg_t.caption = swapped and "TEAM*" or "TEAM"
76	
77	    seg_g.tooltip = "Chat is GLOBAL — everyone on the server sees " .. whose .. "."
78	        .. (is_local and ("\nClick to switch " .. moves .. " to global chat.") or "")
79	    seg_t.tooltip = "Chat is TEAM-ONLY — messages stay inside your team."
80	        .. " Start a message with ! to shout globally."
81	        .. (is_local and "" or ("\nClick to switch " .. moves .. " to team-only chat."))
82	        .. (swapped and ("\n* While spectating, other spectators can also"
83	            .. " see your team messages.") or "")

85	    -- Anchor: horizontally centered, just under the screen top. display_
86	    -- resolution can be transiently 0 for a just-connecting player; skipping
87	    -- the write is fine — the next one-second refresh re-anchors.
88	    local res = player.display_resolution
89	    if res and res.width and res.width > 0 then
90	        local scale = player.display_scale or 1

92	            x = math.floor(res.width / 2 - SWITCH_WIDTH * scale / 2),
93	            y = math.floor(10 * scale),
94	        }
95	    end
96	end

98	return M

9	--       message      = "Are you sure you want to leave?\nYour items will be dropped as a corpse.",
10	--       confirm_text = "Leave Team",
11	--       cancel_text  = "Cancel",
12	--       action       = "leave",           -- routed to confirm handlers table
13	--       data         = {some_key = ...},  -- optional, passed back as tags
14	--   })
15	--
16	-- Modules register handlers via confirm.register(action_name, fn).
17	-- The handler is invoked with (player, data_tags) when the user clicks Confirm.
18	
19	local helpers = require("scripts.helpers")
20	
21	local confirm = {}
22	
23	-- Handler registry: { [action_name] = function(player, data) ... end }
24	-- Registered at module load (once), so no desync concerns.
25	local handlers = {}
26	
27	local FRAME_NAME = "sb_confirm_frame"
28	
29	--- Register a confirmation handler for an action name.
30	--- Called during module load (not during gameplay), so it's desync-safe.
31	function confirm.register(action_name, fn)
32	    handlers[action_name] = fn
33	end
34	
35	--- Show the confirmation dialog to a player.
36	function confirm.show(player, opts)
37	    if not (player and player.valid) then return end
38	
39	    -- Close any existing confirm dialog
40	    if player.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME] then
41	        player.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME].destroy()
42	    end
43	
44	    local frame = player.gui.screen.add{
45	        type      = "frame",
46	        name      = FRAME_NAME,
47	        direction = "vertical",
48	    }
49	    frame.auto_center = true
50	
51	    helpers.add_title_bar(frame, opts.title or "Confirm")
52	
53	    -- Message body (supports multi-line via "\n")
54	    local msg = frame.add{
55	        type    = "label",
56	        caption = opts.message or "Are you sure?",
57	    }
58	    msg.style.single_line     = false
59	    msg.style.maximal_width   = 420
60	    msg.style.top_margin      = 6
61	    msg.style.bottom_margin   = 8
62	    msg.style.left_margin     = 4
63	    msg.style.right_margin    = 4
64	
65	    frame.add{type = "line"}
66	
67	    -- Button row
68	    local btn_flow = frame.add{type = "flow", direction = "horizontal"}
69	    btn_flow.style.top_margin           = 6
70	    btn_flow.style.bottom_margin        = 2
71	    btn_flow.style.horizontally_stretchable = true
72	
73	    local cancel_btn = btn_flow.add{
74	        type    = "button",
75	        name    = "sb_confirm_cancel",
76	        caption = opts.cancel_text or "Cancel",
77	        style   = "back_button",
78	    }
79	    cancel_btn.style.horizontally_stretchable = true
80	
81	    -- Build tags merging data + action
82	    local tags = {sb_confirm = true, action = opts.action}
83	    if opts.data then
84	        for k, v in pairs(opts.data) do tags[k] = v end
85	    end
86	
87	    local confirm_btn = btn_flow.add{
88	        type    = "button",
89	        name    = "sb_confirm_ok",
90	        caption = opts.confirm_text or "Confirm",
91	        style   = "confirm_button",
92	        tags    = tags,
93	    }
94	    confirm_btn.style.horizontally_stretchable = true
95	
96	    player.opened = frame
97	end
98	
99	--- Close the confirmation dialog for a player.
100	local function close(player)
101	    if player and player.valid and player.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME] then
102	        player.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME].destroy()
103	    end
104	end
105	
106	--- Handle GUI click. Returns true if consumed.
107	function confirm.on_gui_click(event)
108	    local el = event.element
109	    if not el or not el.valid then return false end
110	    local player = game.get_player(event.player_index)
111	    if not player then return false end
112	
113	    if el.name == "sb_confirm_cancel" then
114	        close(player)
115	        return true
116	    end
117	
118	    if el.name == "sb_confirm_ok" and el.tags and el.tags.sb_confirm then
119	        local action  = el.tags.action
120	        local data    = el.tags  -- includes everything the caller passed
121	        close(player)
122	        local fn = handlers[action]
123	        if fn then fn(player, data) end
124	        return true
125	    end
126	
127	    return false
128	end
129	
130	return confirm

34	    state.physical    = state.physical    or {}
35	    return state
36	end
37	
38	-- ─── Public API ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
39	
40	--- Toggle a player in the viewer's follow cam grid.
41	function follow_cam.toggle_target(viewer, target_index)
42	    if not (viewer and viewer.valid) then return end
43	    if viewer.index == target_index then return end
44	    local state = ensure_state(viewer.index)
45	    if state.targets[target_index] then
46	        state.targets[target_index]     = nil
47	        state.zoom_levels[target_index] = nil
48	        state.physical[target_index]    = nil
49	    else
50	        state.targets[target_index] = true
51	    end
52	    fcf.rebuild_frame(viewer, state)
53	end
54	
55	--- Flip a single camera between tracking the target's live view (default) and
56	--- their physical body. Rebuilds so the camera re-aims and the button updates.
57	function follow_cam.toggle_view_mode(viewer, target_index)
58	    if not (viewer and viewer.valid) then return end
59	    local state = storage.follow_cam and storage.follow_cam[viewer.index]
60	    if not (state and state.targets[target_index]) then return end
61	    state.physical = state.physical or {}
62	    state.physical[target_index] = not state.physical[target_index] or nil
63	    fcf.rebuild_frame(viewer, state)
64	end
65	
66	--- Close the follow cam for a viewer (clears all targets).
67	function follow_cam.close(viewer)
68	    if not (viewer and viewer.valid) then return end
69	    if viewer.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME] then
70	        local state = storage.follow_cam and storage.follow_cam[viewer.index]
71	        -- Don't persist the top-left position of a maximized window.
72	        if not (state and state.maximized) then
73	            storage.follow_cam_location = storage.follow_cam_location or {}
74	            storage.follow_cam_location[viewer.index] = viewer.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME].location
75	        end
76	        viewer.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME].destroy()
77	    end
78	    clear_state(viewer.index)
79	end
80	
81	--- Toggle the maximized (fill-screen) layout for the viewer's follow cam.
82	function follow_cam.toggle_maximize(viewer)
83	    if not (viewer and viewer.valid) then return end
84	    local state = ensure_state(viewer.index)
85	    local frame = viewer.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME]
86	    if not (frame and frame.valid) then return end
87	    if not state.maximized then
88	        -- Remember where the normal window sat so Restore can return it there.
89	        storage.follow_cam_location = storage.follow_cam_location or {}
90	        storage.follow_cam_location[viewer.index] = frame.location
91	        state.maximized = true
92	    else
93	        state.maximized = false
94	    end
95	    fcf.rebuild_frame(viewer, state)
96	end
97	
98	--- Esc handler: a maximized follow cam restores to its original size instead
99	--- of closing. Returns true if it consumed the close.
100	function follow_cam.on_gui_closed(event)
101	    if event.gui_type ~= defines.gui_type.custom then return false end
102	    local el = event.element
103	    if not (el and el.valid and el.name == FRAME_NAME) then return false end
104	    local state = storage.follow_cam and storage.follow_cam[event.player_index]
105	    if not (state and state.maximized) then return false end
106	    local viewer = game.get_player(event.player_index)
107	    if not viewer then return false end
108	    state.maximized = false
109	    fcf.rebuild_frame(viewer, state)
110	    return true
111	end
112	
113	--- Re-fit a maximized follow cam after the viewer resizes the game window
114	--- (or changes UI scale). No-op for normal or closed cams.
115	function follow_cam.on_display_changed(viewer)
116	    if not (viewer and viewer.valid) then return end
117	    local state = storage.follow_cam and storage.follow_cam[viewer.index]
118	    if not (state and state.maximized) then return end
119	    if not viewer.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME] then return end
120	    fcf.rebuild_frame(viewer, state)
121	end
122	
123	--- Return true if the viewer is currently following target_index.
124	function follow_cam.is_following(viewer_index, target_index)
125	    local state = (storage.follow_cam or {})[viewer_index]
126	    return state and state.targets[target_index] == true
127	end
128	
129	-- ─── Tick Update ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
130	
131	--- Update all active follow cams. Called from on_nth_tick(2) in control.lua.
132	function follow_cam.tick()
133	    if not storage.follow_cam then return end
134	    for viewer_idx, state in pairs(storage.follow_cam) do
135	        local viewer = game.get_player(viewer_idx)
136	        if not (viewer and viewer.connected and viewer.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME]) then
137	            storage.follow_cam[viewer_idx] = nil
138	        else
139	            local viewer_force = viewer.force
140	            for target_idx, camera in pairs(state.cameras) do
141	                if camera.valid then
142	                    local target = game.get_player(target_idx)
143	                    if target and target.valid then
144	                        local phys = state.physical and state.physical[target_idx] or false
145	                        local _, surface, position = spectator.resolve_view_for(target, phys)
146	                        if surface and surface.valid and position then
147	                            camera.position      = position
148	                            camera.surface_index = surface.index
149	                            -- Only chart in physical mode: persistently revealing fog
150	                            -- around a pannable live-view camera would be an exploit.
151	                            if phys and viewer_force and viewer_force.valid then
152	                                viewer_force.chart(surface, {
153	                                    {position.x - CHART_RADIUS, position.y - CHART_RADIUS},
154	                                    {position.x + CHART_RADIUS, position.y + CHART_RADIUS},
155	                                })
156	                            end
157	                        end
158	                        -- Keep the "Spectating <team>" flag in sync as the target
159	                        -- enters/leaves spectator mode while the cam is open.
160	                        local label = state.spectate_labels and state.spectate_labels[target_idx]
161	                        if label then fcf.update_spectate_label(label, target) end
162	                    end
163	                end
164	            end
165	        end
166	    end
167	end
168	
169	-- ─── Zoom ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
170	
171	local function adjust_zoom(viewer_index, target_idx, factor)
172	    local state = storage.follow_cam and storage.follow_cam[viewer_index]
173	    if not (state and target_idx) then return end
174	    state.zoom_levels = state.zoom_levels or {}
175	    local current  = state.zoom_levels[target_idx] or CAMERA_ZOOM
176	    local new_zoom = math.max(CAMERA_ZOOM_MIN, math.min(current * factor, CAMERA_ZOOM_MAX))
177	    state.zoom_levels[target_idx] = new_zoom
178	    local cam = state.cameras and state.cameras[target_idx]
179	    if cam and cam.valid then cam.zoom = new_zoom end
180	end
181	
182	-- ─── Click Handler ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
183	
184	function follow_cam.on_gui_click(event)
185	    local el = event.element
186	    if not el or not el.valid then return false end
187	
188	    if el.name == "sb_follow_cam_close" then
189	        local player = game.get_player(event.player_index)
190	        if player then follow_cam.close(player) end
191	        return true
192	    end
193	
194	    if el.name == "sb_follow_cam_maximize" then
195	        local player = game.get_player(event.player_index)
196	        if player then follow_cam.toggle_maximize(player) end
197	        return true
198	    end
199	
200	    local tags = el.tags
201	    if not tags then return false end
202	
203	    if tags.sb_follow_cam_zoom_in then
204	        adjust_zoom(event.player_index, tags.target_idx, CAMERA_ZOOM_STEP)
205	        return true
206	    end
207	
208	    if tags.sb_follow_cam_zoom_out then
209	        adjust_zoom(event.player_index, tags.target_idx, 1 / CAMERA_ZOOM_STEP)
210	        return true
211	    end
212	
213	    if tags.sb_follow_cam_remove then
214	        local player = game.get_player(event.player_index)
215	        if player then follow_cam.toggle_target(player, tags.target_idx) end
216	        return true
217	    end
218	
219	    if tags.sb_follow_cam_view_toggle then
220	        local player = game.get_player(event.player_index)
221	        if player then follow_cam.toggle_view_mode(player, tags.target_idx) end
222	        return true
223	    end
224	
225	    if tags.sb_follow_cam_spectate then
226	        local player = game.get_player(event.player_index)
227	        local target = tags.target_idx and game.get_player(tags.target_idx)
228	        if not (player and player.valid and target and target.valid
229	                and target.connected) then
230	            return true
231	        end
232	        -- Enter the full view at whatever this camera was showing (live view or body).
233	        local st   = storage.follow_cam and storage.follow_cam[event.player_index]
234	        local phys = st and st.physical and st.physical[tags.target_idx] or false
235	        local target_force, surface, position = spectator.resolve_view_for(target, phys)
236	        local viewer_force = game.forces[spectator.get_effective_force(player)]
237	        if not (viewer_force and target_force
238	                and surface and surface.valid and position) then
239	            return true
240	        end
241	        if spectator.needs_spectator_mode(viewer_force, target_force) then
242	            if spectator.is_spectating(player) then
243	                spectator.switch_target(player, target_force, surface, position, target)
244	            else
245	                spectator.enter(player, target_force, surface, position, target)
246	            end
247	        else
248	            spectator.enter_friend_view(player, surface, position, target_force, target)
249	        end
250	        return true
251	    end
252	
253	    return false
254	end
255	
256	-- ─── Lifecycle ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
257	
258	--- Rebuild all open follow cams (e.g. when a target disconnects).
259	function follow_cam.rebuild_all()
260	    if not storage.follow_cam then return end
261	    for viewer_idx, state in pairs(storage.follow_cam) do
262	        local viewer = game.get_player(viewer_idx)
263	        if viewer and viewer.connected and viewer.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME] then
264	            fcf.rebuild_frame(viewer, state)
265	        else
266	            storage.follow_cam[viewer_idx] = nil
267	        end
268	    end
269	end
270	
271	--- Called when a player disconnects: close their cam and drop them from others.
272	function follow_cam.on_player_left(player)
273	    if player.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME] then
274	        player.gui.screen[FRAME_NAME].destroy()
275	    end
276	    clear_state(player.index)
277	    if not storage.follow_cam then return end
278	    for _, state in pairs(storage.follow_cam) do
279	        state.targets[player.index] = nil
280	        if state.zoom_levels then state.zoom_levels[player.index] = nil end
281	        if state.physical    then state.physical[player.index]    = nil end
282	    end
283	    follow_cam.rebuild_all()
284	end
285	
286	return follow_cam

2	-- Author: bits-orio

4	--
5	-- Friend toggle logic extracted from surfaces_gui.lua.
6	-- Mutual friendship semantics: both sides must agree before it
7	-- activates; either side can break it immediately.
8	
9	local spectator     = require("scripts.spectator")
10	local helpers       = require("scripts.helpers")
11	local surface_utils = require("scripts.surface_utils")
12	
13	local friendship = {}
14	
15	-- ─── State Query ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
16	
17	--- Determine friendship checkbox state between viewer and target.
18	--- Returns: label_text, label_color, tooltip, checked
19	-- Friendship checkbox states:
20	-- State                     | Label            | Color  | Checked | Tooltip
21	-- No intents                | "request friend" | blue   | no      | "Send friend request to X"
22	-- I requested, they haven't | "request pending"| yellow | yes     | "Withdraw friend request to X"
23	-- They requested, I haven't | "request pending"| yellow | no      | "Accept friend request from X"
24	-- Mutual active             | "friends"        | green  | yes     | "Break friendship with X"
25	function friendship.get_state(viewer_force_name, target_force_name, viewer_force, target_force, owner)
26	    local intents      = storage.friend_intents or {}
27	    local my_intent    = intents[viewer_force_name]
28	        and intents[viewer_force_name][target_force_name] or false
29	    local their_intent = intents[target_force_name]
30	        and intents[target_force_name][viewer_force_name] or false
31	    local is_mutual    = viewer_force.get_friend(target_force)
32	
33	    if is_mutual then
34	        return "friends", {0, 1, 0}, "Break friendship with " .. owner, true
35	    elseif my_intent then
36	        return "request pending", {1, 0.8, 0}, "Withdraw friend request to " .. owner, true
37	    elseif their_intent then
38	        return "request pending", {1, 0.8, 0}, "Accept friend request from " .. owner, false
39	    else
40	        return "request friend", {0.4, 0.7, 1}, "Send friend request to " .. owner, false
41	    end
42	end
43	
44	-- ─── Internal Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
45	
46	--- Activate mutual friendship between two forces.
47	local function activate(viewer_force, target_force)
48	    viewer_force.set_friend(target_force, true)
49	    target_force.set_friend(viewer_force, true)
50	    spectator.on_friend_changed(viewer_force, target_force, true)
51	    spectator.on_friend_changed(target_force, viewer_force, true)
52	    surface_utils.update_visibility(viewer_force, target_force, true)
53	end
54	
55	--- Break mutual friendship between two forces.
56	local function break_mutual(viewer_force_name, target_force_name, viewer_force, target_force)
57	    storage.friend_intents[target_force_name] = storage.friend_intents[target_force_name] or {}
58	    storage.friend_intents[target_force_name][viewer_force_name] = nil
59	
60	    viewer_force.set_friend(target_force, false)
61	    target_force.set_friend(viewer_force, false)
62	    spectator.on_friend_changed(viewer_force, target_force, false)
63	    spectator.on_friend_changed(target_force, viewer_force, false)
64	    surface_utils.update_visibility(viewer_force, target_force, false)
65	end
66	
67	-- ─── Toggle Handler ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
68	
69	--- Handle friend checkbox toggle.
70	--- Broadcasts the result message. Returns true if GUIs need refresh.
71	function friendship.on_toggle(event)
72	    local element = event.element
73	    if not element or not element.valid then return end
74	    if not (element.tags and element.tags.sb_friend_toggle) then return end
75	
76	    local player = game.get_player(event.player_index)
77	    if not player then return end
78	
79	    local target_force = game.forces[element.tags.sb_target_force]
80	    if not target_force then return end
81	
82	    local viewer_force_name = spectator.get_effective_force(player)
83	    local viewer_force      = game.forces[viewer_force_name]
84	    if not viewer_force then return end
85	
86	    local target_force_name = target_force.name
87	    -- Use team names (not player names) so messages remain correct even when
88	    -- the team leader changes later.
89	    local viewer_tag = helpers.team_tag(viewer_force_name)
90	    local target_tag = helpers.team_tag(target_force_name)
91	
92	    storage.friend_intents = storage.friend_intents or {}
93	    storage.friend_intents[viewer_force_name] = storage.friend_intents[viewer_force_name] or {}
94	
95	    local msg
96	
97	    if element.state then
98	        -- Record this side's intent
99	        storage.friend_intents[viewer_force_name][target_force_name] = true
100	
101	        local reverse = storage.friend_intents[target_force_name]
102	            and storage.friend_intents[target_force_name][viewer_force_name]
103	
104	        if reverse then
105	            activate(viewer_force, target_force)
106	            msg = viewer_tag .. " and " .. target_tag
107	                .. " are now [color=0,1,0]friends[/color]"
108	        else
109	            msg = viewer_tag .. " wants to friend " .. target_tag
110	                .. " [color=1,0.8,0](pending)[/color]"
111	        end
112	    else
113	        -- Remove this side's intent
114	        storage.friend_intents[viewer_force_name][target_force_name] = nil
115	
116	        if viewer_force.get_friend(target_force) then
117	            break_mutual(viewer_force_name, target_force_name, viewer_force, target_force)
118	            msg = viewer_tag .. " and " .. target_tag .. " are no longer friends"
119	        else
120	            msg = viewer_tag .. " withdrew friend request to " .. target_tag
121	        end
122	    end
123	
124	    helpers.broadcast(msg)
125	    return true
126	end
127	
128	--- Break mutual friendship between two forces (if any) and notify the
129	--- spectator + visibility subsystems. Returns true if anything was broken.
130	local function break_pair(force_a, force_b)
131	    if not (force_a.get_friend(force_b) or force_b.get_friend(force_a)) then
132	        return false
133	    end
134	    force_a.set_friend(force_b, false)
135	    force_b.set_friend(force_a, false)
136	    spectator.on_friend_changed(force_a, force_b, false)
137	    spectator.on_friend_changed(force_b, force_a, false)
138	    surface_utils.update_visibility(force_a, force_b, false)
139	    return true
140	end
141	
142	--- Break all existing friendships and clear all intents.
143	--- Called when the friendship admin flag is disabled mid-session.
144	function friendship.break_all()
145	    storage.friend_intents = storage.friend_intents or {}
146	    local any_broken = false
147	    for _, force_a in pairs(game.forces) do
148	        if force_a.name:find("^team%-") then
149	            for _, force_b in pairs(game.forces) do
150	                if force_b.name:find("^team%-") and force_a.index < force_b.index then
151	                    if break_pair(force_a, force_b) then
152	                        any_broken = true
153	                    end
154	                end
155	            end
156	        end
157	    end
158	    storage.friend_intents = {}
159	    if any_broken then
160	        helpers.broadcast("[Admin] All friendships have been dissolved.")
161	    end
162	end
163	
164	--- Break every friendship involving `force_name` and drop intents to/from it.
165	--- Called when a team slot is released so the next occupant doesn't inherit
166	--- the previous team's trust relationships.
167	function friendship.break_all_for(force_name)
168	    local force = game.forces[force_name]
169	    if not force then return end
170	
171	    for _, other in pairs(game.forces) do
172	        if other ~= force and other.name:find("^team%-") then
173	            break_pair(force, other)
174	        end
175	    end
176	
177	    storage.friend_intents = storage.friend_intents or {}
178	    storage.friend_intents[force_name] = nil
179	    for _, intents in pairs(storage.friend_intents) do
180	        intents[force_name] = nil
181	    end
182	end
183	
184	return friendship

4	--
5	-- Persistent top-bar team chip — "TeamName | 1h 44m 46s" in a framed one-line
6	-- row right of the nav buttons — plus ownership of the center-top chat switch
7	-- (gui/chat_switch.lua renders it; the click handlers live here). The birth

13	-- leader colour drift) are rewritten once a second from the 60-tick handler
14	-- in events/ticks.lua. Creation/destruction also happens there, plus eagerly
15	-- on join and force change so the clock appears without a one-second lag.
16	-- A member peeking at another team via spectator mode keeps their OWN team's
17	-- clock: display follows the effective force, not player.force.
18	--
19	-- The chat-channel badge (scripts/chat_tag.lua) rides this same refresh. It is
20	-- not GUI, but it is driven by exactly the same input — the player's effective
21	-- force — so hanging it here gives it every join, force-change and channel-
22	-- switch call site for free, plus the one-second pass as a self-heal. A badge
23	-- that lied about the channel would be worse than no badge, so it must never
24	-- depend on a call site someone forgets to add.

26	local helpers        = require("scripts.helpers")
27	local nav            = require("gui.nav")
28	local spectator      = require("scripts.spectator")
29	local team_clock     = require("scripts.team_clock")

38	
39	local NOT_STARTED_COLOR = {0.6, 0.6, 0.6}
40	local CLOCK_COLOR       = {1, 1, 1}  -- pure white: the translucent panel eats contrast
41	
42	--- Caption + tooltip + colour for a team's clock label. Shared with the
43	--- Teams GUI per-card clocks (gui/team_card.lua) so both read identically.
44	--- Returns nil caption for a non-team force.
45	function M.clock_caption(force_name)
46	    if not helpers.is_team_force(force_name) then return nil end
47	
48	    local start = (storage.team_clock_start or {})[force_name]
49	    if not start then
50	        return "[img=utility/clock] not started",
51	            "The clock starts when the team leader clicks Start Playing.",
52	            NOT_STARTED_COLOR
53	    end
54	
55	    local elapsed = game.tick - start
56	    if elapsed < 0 then elapsed = 0 end
57	    local tooltip = "Time since the team started playing — the official time"
58	        .. " for records and awards."
59	    local online = team_clock.online_ticks(force_name)
60	    if online and online < elapsed then
61	        tooltip = tooltip .. "\nOnline (at least one member connected): "
62	            .. helpers.fmt_duration(online)

67	
68	--- Create, update, or remove the top-bar team chip (name | clock, framed,
69	--- one line, sitting right of the nav buttons) plus the center-top chat
70	--- switch, based on the player's effective force. Idempotent; safe from any
71	--- event context.
72	function M.update_player(player)
73	    if not (player and player.valid) then return end
74	    local top  = player.gui.top
75	    local root = top[FLOW_NAME]
76	
77	    local force_name = spectator.get_effective_force(player)
78	    local caption, tooltip, color = M.clock_caption(force_name)
79	    if not caption then
80	        if root then root.destroy() end
81	        chat_switch.update_player(player, nil)
82	        chat_tag.update_player(player, nil)
83	        return
84	    end
85	
86	    -- Defensive rebuild across layout versions: the style-name check retires
87	    -- both the pre-chip label stack and the earlier opaque padded chip.
88	    if root and (not root.mts_hud_row or root.style.name ~= "mts_hud_chip_frame") then
89	        root.destroy(); root = nil
90	    end
91	
92	    if not root then
93	        root = top.add{type = "frame", name = FLOW_NAME,
94	            style = "mts_hud_chip_frame", direction = "vertical"}
95	        root.style.left_margin = 8
96	        root.style.top_margin  = 15  -- centers the chip on the 56px nav-button row
97	        local row = root.add{type = "flow", name = "mts_hud_row", direction = "horizontal"}
98	        row.style.vertical_align     = "center"
99	        row.style.horizontal_spacing = 6
100	        local name_lbl = row.add{type = "label", name = "mts_hud_team_name"}
101	        name_lbl.style.font = "mts-hud-bold"
102	        local time_lbl = row.add{type = "label", name = "mts_hud_team_time"}
103	        time_lbl.style.font = "mts-hud-bold"

5	-- Surface creation and chunk generation for the Landing Pen.
6	-- The pen is a circular island with a lab-dark-2 floor, water moat,
7	-- grass ring, and out-of-map void beyond.
8	
9	local pen_info_panel = require("gui.pen_info_panel")
10	
11	local landing_pen_terrain = {}
12	
13	-- ─── Layout Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
14	
15	local PEN_RADIUS   = 15
16	local MOAT_OUTER   = PEN_RADIUS + 3
17	local GRASS_OUTER  = MOAT_OUTER  + 3
18	local SPAWN_RADIUS = 5
19	local MAX_SLOTS    = 8
20	local SURFACE_NAME = "landing-pen"
21	
22	-- Exported for use by landing_pen.lua
23	landing_pen_terrain.SURFACE_NAME = SURFACE_NAME
24	landing_pen_terrain.MAX_SLOTS    = MAX_SLOTS
25	landing_pen_terrain.SPAWN_RADIUS = SPAWN_RADIUS
26	
27	-- ─── Tile Generation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
28	
29	local function tile_for_distance(r)
30	    if r < PEN_RADIUS then
31	        return "lab-dark-2"
32	    elseif r < MOAT_OUTER then
33	        return "water"
34	    elseif r < GRASS_OUTER then
35	        return "grass-1"
36	    else
37	        return "out-of-map"
38	    end
39	end
40	
41	-- ─── Surface Creation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
42	
43	--- Create the landing-pen surface with a circular island and ground text.
44	function landing_pen_terrain.get_or_create_surface()
45	    local surface = game.surfaces[SURFACE_NAME]
46	    local created = false
47	    if not surface then
48	        surface = game.create_surface(SURFACE_NAME, {
49	            default_enable_all_autoplace_controls = false,
50	            autoplace_settings = {
51	                entity     = {treat_missing_as_default = false, settings = {}},
52	                tile       = {treat_missing_as_default = false, settings = {}},
53	                decorative = {treat_missing_as_default = false, settings = {}},
54	            },
55	        })
56	        surface.always_day  = true
57	        surface.show_clouds = false
58	
59	        surface.request_to_generate_chunks({x = 0, y = 0}, 2)
60	        surface.force_generate_chunk_requests()
61	
62	        rendering.draw_text{
63	            text = "MULTI-TEAM SUPPORT", surface = surface,
64	            target = {x = 0, y = -8},
65	            color = {r = 0.9, g = 0.7, b = 0.3, a = 0.8},
66	            scale = 5, font = "default-large-bold", alignment = "center",
67	        }
68	        rendering.draw_text{
69	            text = "Spawn when ready", surface = surface,
70	            target = {x = 0, y = 4},
71	            color = {r = 1.0, g = 1.0, b = 1.0, a = 0.8},
72	            scale = 3, font = "default-large", alignment = "center",
73	        }
74	        created = true
75	    end
76	
77	    -- Admin-editable info panel at dead center + chart the island for every
78	    -- force so it's never a black island when viewed from afar.
79	    pen_info_panel.ensure(surface)
80	    if created then pen_info_panel.chart_all() end
81	
82	    return surface
83	end
84	
85	-- ─── Chunk Handler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
86	
87	--- Tiles every chunk on the pen surface with the ring layout.
88	function landing_pen_terrain.on_chunk_generated(event)
89	    if event.surface.name ~= SURFACE_NAME then return end
90	
91	    local area  = event.area
92	    local tiles = {}
93	    for x = area.left_top.x, area.right_bottom.x - 1 do
94	        for y = area.left_top.y, area.right_bottom.y - 1 do
95	            local r = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)
96	            tiles[#tiles + 1] = {name = tile_for_distance(r), position = {x, y}}
97	        end
98	    end
99	    event.surface.set_tiles(tiles)
100	
101	    for _, entity in ipairs(event.surface.find_entities(area)) do
102	        -- Keep player characters and the admin info panel; clear everything else
103	        -- so a regenerated chunk can't wipe the centre panel.
104	        if entity.type ~= "character" and not pen_info_panel.is_panel(entity) then
105	            entity.destroy()
106	        end
107	    end
108	end
109	
110	-- ─── Spawn Positions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
111	
112	--- Map a 0-based slot index to a world position on the spawn ring.
113	function landing_pen_terrain.get_spawn_position(slot)
114	    local angle = slot * (2 * math.pi / MAX_SLOTS)
115	    return {
116	        x = math.floor(SPAWN_RADIUS * math.cos(angle) + 0.5),
117	        y = math.floor(SPAWN_RADIUS * math.sin(angle) + 0.5),
118	    }
119	end
120	
121	return landing_pen_terrain
